title: 200万销量、2000万玩家之后，AI游戏找到新方向了？
sourceType: secondary editorial; states it compiles/translates Naavik

lessons.reportedIdea: Context-dependent responses can change how players verify information; novelty and content limitations can weaken replay value.
lessons.adaptation: Make evidence provenance and next verification actions visible; revisit authored evidence after state changes.

lessons.reportedIdea: Freeform player proposals expand the action vocabulary; AI adjudication and inference cost become part of the product.
lessons.adaptation: Offer freeform hypothesis notes alongside mechanically grounded source checks; keep formal validation in deterministic simulation.

lessons.reportedIdea: Persistent relationships/context can support engagement, while inference cost and monetization changes can affect experience; causal attribution is uncertain.
lessons.adaptation: Keep player-authored hypothesis notes locally between visits; use zero-network reflection and preserve premium, unrestricted practice.

scope.claim: No runtime model has been integrated; this is a source-informed offline gameplay feature.
